learned: 2026-10-05, by agent pass: 73 products (69 cannabis, 4 merch tees with size variants), all 'Default Title' variants, prices 0.00. offhours.com is a parked domain; use offhoursbrand.com. 2026-10-08, curation pass: the site's collections name the families (Effect-Based Gummies, which also holds the Low THC gummies and the Effect-Based AIOs; Effect-based Ropes; Live Rosin Gummies/Ropes/AIO; Resin Ropes; Originals; Off-box; Syrup).
notes: NY only: the site is New York's (NY OCM processor license in the footer), so no state filter is needed.

Titles are short and product_type carries the line and format: 'Originals (Cartridge)', 'Originals (AIO)', 'Off-box', 'Live Rosin AIO', 'Effect-Based AIO', 'Live Rosin' (gummies), 'Gummy Rope', 'Gummies' (effect gummies), 'Low THC', 'Syrup'. The same strain is both an Originals cart and AIO, so product_type decides the subtype.

Size is only in body_html: 'SIZE: 10CT STRENGTH: 100MG THC (10MG/SERVING)' for edibles, 'Size: 0.5g' for the newer vapes, a '1G CARTRIDGE' / '1G ALL-IN-ONE VAPE PEN' header for Originals. The Effect-Based AIO bodies open with '1G ALL-IN-ONE VAPE PEN' but say 'Size: 0.5g', and NY stores sell them as 0.5g, so their rule reads 'Size:'.

Effect products are one family, 'Effect-Based' (2026-10-08 curation): the site files the effect gummies, the Low THC gummies and the Effect-Based AIOs in one collection, 'Effect-Based Gummies', titles the ropes '<Name> Effect-Based Rope', and every tin prints 'Formulated with effect-based terpenes'. Effect names (Offline, Unwind) span gummies and vapes, the tell that they are not lines. So the line is Effect-Based and the product's name is the effect name plus the FLAVOR field ('Mellow Blue Raspberry', 'Livewire Razz Lemonade'); AIOs have no flavor and are the name before the dot ('Unwind. (Calm)' is Unwind). Numbered Live Rosin drops are '#025 Cultivar “Flavor”'; the quoted flavor is the strain, as stores write it. Ropes are named by cultivar (Gelonade, Berry Pie, and 'Galactic Guava “Passionfruit Mango Guava”', which stores sell as Galactic Guava); the Galactic Guava rope is line Live Rosin (its tin: '(1) Live Rosin Infused Gummy Rope'; the site's 'Live Rosin Ropes' collection).

Daydream's FLAVOR field repeats Jelly RNTZ's ('Strawberry Acai with Coconut'); its description calls it 'Pink Berries' and stores sell it as 'Daydream Pink Berry'. A rule guarded on that description names it Daydream Pink Berry.

Awaken's FLAVOR field says 'Orange Punch', but its tin prints 'Orangeade' (site image Awaken_990f9a61..., 10:4:2 THC:CBG:THCV) as the old 10:2 tin did, and 17 stores sell it as Awaken Orangeade. One product, reformulated: a guarded rule names it Awaken Orangeade.
Low THC gummies state CBD/CBG/CBN first ('Qty: 20 Gummies Potency: 500mg CBD ... + 20mg THC'). An edible's size is its THC, so Unwind is 20mg; Lights Out and Utopia have no THC and are skipped.

'#021 Galactic Guava “Sour Mango Guava”' says 'SIZE: 1CT' but its tin prints 'Batch ZZ ... (10) Live Rosin Infused Gummies, 10mg THC/gummy (100mg THC/pack)' and stores sell it as a 10pk; a rule guarded on the 1CT text sets 10CT. The title's #021 is also Ice Cream Zundae's number; its lab code is OH-LROG-022.
Low THC Unwind: 'Qty: 20 Gummies ... + 20mg THC' is 20pk 20mg; a guarded rule sets it, since 'Qty: 20 Gummies' does not read as a pack.

store_aliases (2026-10-08): stores' line/strain splits of site products: Ice Cream Zundae 'Mystery Flavor' (#021 'Mystery'), the effect ropes without their flavor (Livewire, Melt, Overglow, 'Party Animal (Party)'), the Galactic Guava rope as 'Galactic Guava Sour Mango Passionfruit', and Awaken as 'Orange Punch' (its FLAVOR field), and the AIOs as '(Unwind) Calm' and 'On. (Energy)'.

Ropes are their own subtype (2026-10-10): product_type 'Gummy Rope' is edible/rope. The Galactic Guava rope and the '#021 Galactic Guava “Sour Mango Guava”' 10-pack share a name, and as one subtype Jev split listings between them about 50/50; as two, the subtype settles it.

skip.why: no THC (CBD, CBG and CBN only), so no THC dose to size it by

category.why: a rope is one long gummy strip (100mg, 1CT), sold apart from the 10-packs; stores write 'Gummy Rope' or 'Rope', and a rope and a 10-pack can share a flavor name (Galactic Guava)

store_skip.why: the '#021 Galactic Guava “Sour Mango Guava”' 10-pack under its cultivar name: the site's product is Sour Mango Guava, and Galactic Guava alone is the rope (subtype rope since 2026-10-10)
